title: Tribute Summon L5-1
source: Port-authored setup from Tools/puzzles/generate_puzzles.py template 'tribute_summon', level 5, variant 1. The line uses engine-supported cards but is not a GBA fixed-board reconstruction.
notes: Tribute Mystical Elf, La Jinn the Mystical Genie of the Lamp for Blue-Eyes White Dragon, then attack for exactly 5400.

canon_reference.setup_status: canon setup unavailable; this file uses a port-authored template
solution_steps: Fusion summon Mokey Mokey King using the three Mokey Mokeys in your hand and Polymerization.
Run Mokey Mokey King into Big Koala.
Run one of the Mokey Mokeys summoned into Big Koala - the remaining Mokey Mokeys should now attack first Big Koala, then directly.
Activate Call of the Haunted to get Mokey Mokey (not the King) back.
Attack directly with the last Mokey Mokey and with Catapult Turtle.
Catapult all monsters on the field (and finally Catapult Turtle) for game.
